h1: BigCommerce store management, a first sprint
overview: Hand us the routine work in your BigCommerce store for a first round. We clear the backlog of product edits, check recent orders for problems, update stock and prices from your sheet, review your apps and settings, and tidy the admin. You get a short report showing what was done and what needs your attention. Ongoing monthly management is quoted separately once we know how much help you need.

faq: This is a fixed starter sprint, a first round of work. If you want us to keep going each month, we quote monthly care separately after seeing how much help your store needs.
Support replies are not part of this sprint. We focus on the store itself: products, stock, prices, orders and settings. We can quote support as part of monthly care.
Can you handle refunds and cancellations?
We can review orders and flag problems. Money related actions such as refunds stay with you unless you give us a clear written instruction for each case.
What do you need from me?
Staff access with the right permissions, your supplier sheet or product data, and a list of priorities. We never need your password.
